rows.en: Feel the power of the Batal Bullet! Ha ha ha…
Eleking!! Defeat them! Defeat the Ultra Garrison, no matter what!
(I see… So this girl was the one controlling the kaiju!? All riiight…)

Kyaa!!

Stop it, stop it! Let go, let go of me!!
Why are you doing this?
We wanted to kill every human on Earth and take this beautiful planet for ourselves!
I won't let you do as you please! Now, give back the Ultra Eye!!
Noooo… Stop it, stop it! Ah…!?

The Ultra Eye!

So it was your doing after all, wasn't it?
I hope Eleking finishes you off!

Wait!!

She's so fast on her feet!
Eleking lost! Let's get out of here, quick.
The operation failed… To think they took back the Ultra Eye!
We underestimated Earth too much…
But that doesn't mean we've given up! We'll raise a stronger kaiju, and this time we'll take Earth for sure.
How wonderful… This beautiful planet will be ours, won't it?

It's sure to succeed!

After all, we've learned that Earth men are weak against cute girls…

Hee hee hee…

That's right, it's easy.

…!?

Oh no, they're targeting this spaceship!
Juwa!!
Boy… The one we really couldn't have done without in this incident was you, drifter…

Mm… He sensed this incident before anyone else and tried to warn us of the danger…

Welcome, Dan… We welcome you as the sixth member of the Ultra Garrison!
If I'm the sixth… then he's the seventh member, isn't he?
He…?
I mean the red giant that appeared at the lake. Captain, he's on our side!!

Mm, the seventh member, eh…

In that case… let's call him "Ultraseven".

Ultraseven?

That's right… He's Ultraseven! Thank you, Ultraseven…
Fixed-Star Observer No. 340 from Nebula M78, in other words Ultraseven, borrowed the name Dan Moroboshi and took up the defense of Earth…

The evil organizations are joining hands, and even fighting alongside aliens, scheming to shake the peace. Don't lose, Ultraseven! Together with the Ultra Garrison, protect Earth from the invaders' evil clutches!
Bah, you pathetic fool! Coming running back so easily… Your failure will not be forgiven!

I've taken the woman and the kid hostage… He'll come to take them back for sure! And then… leave it to me!!

Uhyooo, uhyooo!!

This is the entrance to the hideout…

Misao and Hiroshi are probably in there…!?
This is the entrance to the hideout…
What the hell! Let go, I said! You creep!
Misao!
You're the guy from before…
So you've come, Shiro Kazami! This time I'll send you to hell for sure!!
Taki, take care of those two!
Right, leave it to me!
Yuki, take care of those two!
Right, leave it to me!
All right…
Ha ha ha… You transformed! That is your end!
Impossible!?

When you transform, the Batal Bullet makes your body release all its energy, and leads you to your death!

You will die soon!
Drop dead, Rider V3!!
What!?
Well done! Marshal Armor… and Doktor G! Destron's conquest of the world is one step closer!
I will execute Rider V3 and Riderman before long, you'll see.
Grr… Marshal Armor has stolen my glory!

Those two are fine! I've sent them somewhere safe!

But nobody interfere! This one is my prey!!

Marshal Armor… using such dirty tricks! I won't forgive you!
Looks like the surgery was a success…
Yeah… Thank you, you really saved me! Yuki, thanks to you I'm back to normal.
I see, I'm glad. Well then, until next time…

Wait…

You're fighting Destron too. Let's join forces and…
I refuse to cooperate!
You refuse…?

I believed in Destron. Marshal Armor was a bad man, but I thought he was a comrade…

And they…

they tried to execute me… execute me! The grief of being betrayed by those you trusted… you could never understand what it's like!

Look! At this…!

This is the form of my grief! The form of the hatred that left me no other way to live!
Yuki… Don't think you're the only man like that in this world!
Not compared to the wounds Destron dealt me!
Wounds!?

My parents… and even my only sister were killed by Destron…

I'll show you… my other form! Henshin!! V… Three!!

In my body… no ordinary human blood flows!

The only thing left… the only thing left as it was, is my brain!

Yuki… As a cyborg, you must understand this pain… this anguish too! Forget your personal revenge!!

I don't understand… I don't understand!

I did so much for Destron… Damn it! I'll defeat Marshal Armor with my own hands! Is that, is that so wrong?

…………

You're a good man… You don't see many like you these days!
Kazami…

I hate Destron too! They murdered my whole family…

But… even if I defeat Destron, my parents and sister won't come back to life!

I will defeat Destron, no matter what! I'll fight for humanity's freedom too!

But, Yuki… that's not for revenge. It's because I don't want anyone else to lose this peace… people's freedom… the way we did!

Fight alongside us! Yuki… Fight with us!

Kazami…

I… I…

So I still have comrades too… Joji Yuki, Riderman, will fight for his comrades! To protect people's peace and freedom!
Yuki…
Defeat Space Kaiju Eleking!
Defeat Space Kaiju Eleking, Missile Gecko and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat Space Kaiju Eleking, Missile Gecko and all Destron Combatants! Furuhashi must also investigate the huge fallen object!
Defeat Missile Gecko, the Destron Combatants, Space Kaiju Eleking and all of Kelbaan's forces! Dan Moroboshi must also find the Ultra Eye!
Defeat Space Kaiju Eleking, Kelbaan's forces, Missile Gecko and all Destron Combatants! Furuhashi must also investigate the huge fallen object!
Defeat Space Kaiju Eleking and all of Kelbaan's forces!
Defeat Missile Gecko, the Destron Combatants and Space Kaiju Eleking!
Furuhashi or Soga is defeated
